notices: HYPOTHETICAL DECISION SIMULATION: exploratory resource-allocation scenarios computed from an unvalidated point forecast with HYPOTHETICAL operational parameters. Not a validated staffing, budget or service-capacity recommendation for any NYC agency.

ARCHIVED PROJECTION: issued from the frozen snapshot, whose last observed day is 2026-06-30, for the target days 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-30. It is not a live forecast, and it has never been scored: no outcome after 2026-06-30 is in the snapshot.
A scenario with feasibility relaxed_terminal_target has no plan that meets every HYPOTHETICAL constraint: its reported plan and required spends are DIAGNOSTIC values, never budget requests.
The M2 point forecast is not prospectively validated: on M2's confirmation period its MAE over horizons 1-30 was 985 requests/day and its bias -256 requests/day (prediction - actual).
The selected intervals FAILED the pre-registered calibration criteria on the historical evaluation period: these intervals and probabilities are not decision-grade.

demand.notice: HYPOTHETICAL STRESS PATH: each day's marginal M3 quantile, taken day by day. It is not a joint scenario, not a quantile of total demand and carries no probability; the M3 intervals it comes from failed their calibration criteria.

parameters.name: initial_backlog
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative open backlog at the start of the horizon (about 0.7 days of forecast demand); no backlog is observed in the data.

parameters.name: regular_hours_per_day
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative regular staff time per day (for example 550 staff working 8 hours); with the regular productivity it gives 11,000 requests per day, 1.2 % below the forecast mean.

parameters.name: regular_productivity
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative number of requests one staff hour resolves; no productivity is measured in the data.

parameters.name: overtime_productivity
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative: 10 % below regular productivity, for fatigue.

parameters.name: overtime_max_hours_per_day
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative daily overtime limit (about 9 % of regular hours).

parameters.name: overtime_total_hours
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative overtime limit over the 30 days (half the daily limit on average).

parameters.name: surge_max_per_day
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative capacity of an external surge contract.

parameters.name: surge_total
parameters.default_assumption: Not limited in the reference configuration.

parameters.name: surge_available_from_day
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative: the surge contract is available from the first day in the base case.

parameters.name: regular_wage
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative loaded cost of a regular staff hour; not an NYC pay rate.

parameters.name: overtime_wage
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative overtime cost (1.5 times the regular wage): 26.67 USD per request at overtime productivity.

parameters.name: surge_price
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative price of one externally processed request (more than overtime per request).

parameters.name: backlog_penalty
parameters.default_assumption: Notional weight on each request waiting overnight; a preference for less waiting, not a cash cost.

parameters.name: terminal_penalty
parameters.default_assumption: No extra notional weight on the backlog left after the last day (the terminal target constrains it instead).

parameters.name: terminal_backlog_max
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative target for the backlog left after the last day (half of the initial backlog).

parameters.name: backlog_trigger
parameters.default_assumption: Trigger of the backlog-trigger rule, set equal to the terminal target.

parameters.name: discretionary_budget
parameters.default_assumption: Illustrative cash available for overtime and surge over the 30 days; the regular staff cost is committed and reported separately.

notes: Every value is HYPOTHETICAL. Defaults are the illustrative values of the M4 reference configuration, chosen to exercise the model, not estimates.
Money and penalty rates are 0 or at least 0.01; smaller nonzero rates would be dropped by the solver.
A regular capacity (hours x productivity) within 1 % of the legacy demand percentile is rejected (422 simulation_rejected): a demand percentile is never a service capacity.
